// diagnostic

E3110

Lane `{lane}` isn't valid on `{type}`.

What

Lane `{lane}` isn't valid on `{type}`.

Why

Swizzle members name lanes with `x`/`y`/`z`/`w`; each type exposes only its lane count (`Vec2`: x/y, `Vec3`: x/y/z, …).

Fix

use only the lanes defined for `{type}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3110: tests/ui/swizzle_invalid_lane.stderr.

Error [E3110]: lane `z` isn't valid on `Vec2`
  --> tests/ui/swizzle_invalid_lane.jet:4:13
    |
  4 |     print(v.z)
    |             ^
 Why: swizzle members name lanes with x/y/z/w — `Vec2` only has x and y
 Fix: use only the lanes defined for `Vec2`
